notes.text: USJ's Christmas Eve opening hours and ticket price are NOT confirmed. Check usj.co.jp before you buy or set alarms. The KFC barrel reservation window isn't confirmed either, so check kfc.co.jp.
Cold all day and dark well before the evening show. Wear hats and gloves and bring a layer you can stuff in a bag.
Passports, IC cards topped up, and the Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass. The pass covers the JR legs; the Hanshin hop goes on the IC card.

stops.summary: Onigiri and hot coffee to eat in the gate queue, because park breakfast prices are a scam.
stops.story: Christmas Eve at USJ is a crowd sport, and the winners are already at the gate while everyone else is still choosing a snack. Grab hot canned coffee and onigiri here and eat them in line with your breath steaming in the dark.
how: Everyone buys their own: onigiri, a hot drink, something sweet for later.
Hanshin Namba line 07:01 from Kujō, one stop to Nishikujō (07:03).
Change to the JR Yumesaki line at 07:13, arriving Universal City 07:19. The JR leg is on the pass.
tips: Hot drinks are in the heated cabinet by the counter, not the fridge.
If someone oversleeps, a taxi is 19 min, but nobody gets left behind.
wishes: We want to maximise all the time we've got in the country

stops.summary: Rope-drop Super Nintendo World, then stay past dark for the Christmas night show in Gramercy Park.
stops.story: It's USJ's 25th-anniversary winter season, and on Christmas Eve half of Kansai has the same idea as you. The prize is the new night show, Light Up the Night, on the fake New York street of Gramercy Park, plus Joy of Lights, back after 9 years.
how: Be at the gate by 07:30 and go straight to Super Nintendo World when it opens.
No Express Pass? Grab the free timed-entry ticket for Super Nintendo World in the USJ app as soon as you're in.
Lunch inside, then hold a spot in Gramercy Park for the 17:30 Light Up the Night show (about 30 min).
Leave by 18:15 for the 18:34 JR train to Nishikujō.
tips: Dec 24 hours and price aren't confirmed and Google lists no hours either, so check usj.co.jp. Last year the price went up ¥1,000 from 24 Dec.
Buy all 8 tickets in one order so Express ride times match. Only Express Pass 5 and 7 include Mario Kart.
The Joy of Lights viewing area is from ¥1,700 on top of admission. Only worth it if you want the front.
stops.cost: Studio Pass about ¥10,900 pp (dynamic, unconfirmed for 24 Dec, so check); Express Pass 5 from ¥16,800 extra
stops.booking: Dated tickets on the official USJ web store; Express Passes sell out
stops.hours: Not confirmed for 24 Dec: check the calendar on usj.co.jp
wishes: We love to do it all
We want to maximise all the time we've got in the country

stops.summary: Supermarket raid for the party: beer, chu-hi, sake, Christmas cake and sides, split eight ways.
stops.story: On Christmas Eve Japanese supermarkets are stacked with whole Christmas cakes and party platters, all ready for people like you. This is where the house party gets its booze and everything that isn't fried chicken.
how: Split up: two on drinks, two on cake, the rest on salads and snacks.
If the KFC reservation fell through, grab fried chicken and party platters here too.
One person pays, everyone settles up on the walk.
Osaka Metro Chuo line 19:35 from Bentenchō, one stop to Kujō (19:37).
tips: It's open until 24:00, so it's also the backup if KFC goes sideways.
The phone line is Japanese only and stops answering at 20:00, so don't plan on calling ahead.

stops.summary: Pick up the Christmas Party Barrels: Japan's weirdest, most sacred Christmas Eve tradition.
stops.story: In Japan, Christmas Eve means KFC, and families reserve their buckets weeks ahead like concert tickets. The eight of you walking back through Kujō in the dark with barrels of fried chicken is the story.
how: Reserve ahead and pick a pickup slot before 20:00. The store closes at 21:00.
Online preorder often fails for foreigners. Ask the Kujō host to help, or reserve in person.
Check the order at the counter, then walk back to Kujō House (17 min).
tips: The reservation window isn't confirmed, so check kfc.co.jp. Last year you got ¥500 off for reserving by Dec 12.
No reservation? Don't queue and hope. Buy Life's fried chicken and platters at the stop before.
stops.booking: Reserve ahead (window not confirmed, so check kfc.co.jp); ask the Kujō host if online preorder fails
wishes: A KFC Christmas party barrel on Christmas Eve

stops.summary: Barrels, cake and cans at the house, and bed by about 23:00: tomorrow ends in a Round1 all-nighter.
stops.story: After a day of crowds this is the reset: chicken, cake and drinks spread across the floor at Kujō House, with nowhere to be. The early night is tactical, because Christmas Day runs from Nara to Round1 and doesn't stop until the first train.
how: Pack the big suitcases tonight, because they go to Tokyo by TA-Q-BIN in the morning.
Lay out the Santa suits so tomorrow is just dress and go.
tips: It's a rented house on a residential street, so keep the noise down.
wishes: A KFC Christmas party barrel on Christmas Eve
